notes: Tarrant elections page links 'Election Results' to Clarity EID 127297 (Nov 2026). Tarrant's Clarity elections.json lists only a May 2025 election, so phase1.clarity_timeline reported all three 'not listed'; the same check 1 functions were run from scratch on the EIDs linked from the county's own past-election pages: 122489 (Nov 2024), 125924 (Mar 2026 primary, both parties), 126079 (May 2026 runoff). Some versions return 404 (8 of 26; 16 of 32; 3 of 19), none of them the deciding night updates. Election-day precinct votes (VoteType 'Election') checked per update. Runoff: every night detail.xml (8:54 PM to 11:34 PM CDT) has candidate values 'protected' (county totals included), while summary.json of the same version shows county totals (e.g. Cornyn 38382, Paxton 57707); the county posted hourly 'No Later Than ... Results Report' cumulative PDFs (county totals, run time 11:18 PM, Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 04:29:30 GMT = 11:29 PM CDT); precinct numbers first appear in Clarity version 373430 (6/2/2026 1:31:21 PM CDT) and the 'Precinct Results Report / Official Results' PDF (run date 06/16/2026). The county server gives real per-file Last-Modified values. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin).
tag_rationale: The 2024 general and 2026 primary were LIVE by check 1 (Clarity update log); the 2026 runoff was LATER. Two elections share LIVE, so the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT with high confidence.

2024_general.fact: Clarity EID 122489: 11 night updates from 11/5/2024 7:04:56 PM CST to 11/6/2024 12:46:42 AM CST, each with 692-693 precincts with nonzero candidate votes; election-day precinct votes first at 9:10:34 PM (594 precincts), 9:58:36 PM (622), 12:46:42 AM (685).

2026_primary.fact: Clarity EID 125924: 9 night updates from 3/3/2026 7:00:55 PM CST to 3/4/2026 2:57:30 AM CST with 688-707 precincts with votes; election-day precinct votes first at 8:59:09 PM (39 precincts), 9:55:22 PM (496), 2:57:30 AM (672).

2026_runoff.fact: Clarity EID 126079: 7 night updates (5/26/2026 8:54:07 PM to 11:34:13 PM CDT), all with 0 precincts with readable candidate votes (values 'protected'); first precinct numbers in version 373430, 6/2/2026 1:31:21 PM CDT (699 precincts). County-posted night reports are cumulative county totals ('Cumulative Results Report ... Unofficial Results ... Run Time 11:18 PM'); 'Precinct Results Report ... Official Results ... Run Date 06/16/2026'.
